title: 55 Oakcourt Lawn, Palmerstown, Dublin 20, D20R209
description:
Premium Collection LWK are delighted to introduce No. 55 Oak Court Lawn, Palmerstown, to the market.

Nestled in a mature and peaceful cul-de-sac setting, No. 55 Oak Court Lawn is an impressive and beautifully presented two-bedroom, two-bathroom home that has been thoughtfully extended, fully renovated and upgraded by its current owners.

Presented in excellent condition throughout, this stylish property combines contemporary interiors with a mature residential setting, creating a superb turnkey home that is ready for immediate occupation. The property also benefits from a converted attic room, providing valuable additional space and excellent versatility for modern family living, working from home or guest accommodation.

One of the standout features is the superb open-plan living and dining space, which provides a bright and welcoming heart to the home. The contemporary kitchen is fitted with an excellent range of wall and floor units, offering generous storage and ample worktop space. From the dining area, sliding doors open directly onto a private patio, creating a natural connection between the indoor and outdoor living spaces.

The two bedrooms and two bathrooms are conveniently positioned on the ground floor, while the converted attic provides an additional flexible room currently used a  third bedroom. Finished with laminate flooring, Velux windows and built-in storage, this generous space significantly enhances the overall accommodation and offers a variety of potential uses.

Outside, the property enjoys a private and attractive setting within this established cul-de-sac, together with off-street parking.

The location is another significant attraction. Oak Court Lawn is within easy walking distance of Palmerstown Village, SuperValu and a wide range of local shops, cafés and amenities. There are excellent transport links nearby, with Dublin City Centre approximately 7km away and easy access to the M50, M4 and wider Dublin road network.

The combination of its turnkey condition, contemporary finish, generous accommodation, converted attic and peaceful cul-de-sac location makes No. 55 Oak Court Lawn a particularly appealing home for buyers seeking a stylish property in a mature and convenient location.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, presentation and versatility this impressive home has to offer.

Highlights

* Fully renovated and upgraded throughout
* Stylish contemporary interior
* Extended two-bedroom, two-bathroom home
* Converted attic room with Velux windows and built-in storage
* Excellent open-plan living and dining space
* Contemporary fitted kitchen
* Private patio area
* Off-street parking
* Peaceful, mature cul-de-sac setting
* Walking distance to Palmerstown Village and SuperValu
* Excellent transport links to Dublin City Centre, M50 and M4
* BER C
